prompts.project: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone website hero vignette for AeroSense iGEM wiki. A cohesive contemporary cut-paper / risograph illustration, friendly and playful yet sophisticated editorial design. Bold crisp silhouettes, subtle grain inside colored forms, tactile overlapping paper layers, confident irregular outlines, no faded washed-out texture. Flat 2D handmade print aesthetic, never glossy 3D. Compact balanced composition centered in a square, main subject occupies 82% of frame, transparent background, ample 6% transparent breathing margin. No background paper, no rectangle, no border, no backdrop blob, no text, no letters, no labels, no numerals, no logos, no decorative chart axes. Image must remain readable at 280px. Subject and palette: A lively friendly fruit fly seen three-quarter side, paired with a little green leaf and a curved trail of golden scent dots; fly anatomically inspired but a bold editorial cartoon, no smiling face. Forest green #247458, mint #a8ebc7, ochre.
